scope: US-incorporated SEC registrants with an original 10-K in 2016 Q1 and a matching SEC Financial Statement Data Set row

sampling_frame.decision_filing: earliest accepted original 10-K in 2016 Q1 per CIK; 10-K/A is not an original filing
sampling_frame.issuer_identity: zero-padded SEC CIK; one sampled decision per CIK
sampling_frame.country_rule: use countryinc from the contemporaneous 2016 Q1 SEC dataset; include US only
sampling_frame.industry_rule: use SIC from the contemporaneous dataset and map to the listed broad SIC divisions; blank or invalid SIC is its own unclassified stratum

sample.allocation: one issuer minimum per non-empty SIC stratum, then proportional allocation of remaining places by stratum population using largest remainder
sample.within_stratum_order: ascending SHA-256 of UTF-8(seed + NUL + zero-padded CIK)
sample.nonresponse: do not replace selected issuers; retain each in the denominator with an explicit retrieval or data exclusion reason

measurement.valuation_timestamp: exact SEC acceptanceDateTime of the sampled decision filing
measurement.history_window: latest five distinct annual report periods available at the valuation timestamp
measurement.input_filing_rule: original 10-K only, accepted no later than the valuation timestamp; retain amendments separately and never substitute amendment facts for original facts
measurement.annual_duration_rule: FY duration facts with 350-380 day spans; instant facts must have no start date
measurement.candidate_history_rule: at least three complete periods in the latest five; measurement only, not a pre-approved or verified threshold
measurement.oos_label_rule: the first subsequently accepted original 10-K with a later report period; select label facts only from that accession and retain later amendments separately
measurement.uncertainty: report two-sided 95% Wilson intervals with issuer as the independent cluster; n=100 targets at most 0.10 worst-case absolute margin for cohort-wide binary proportions; industry results are descriptive unless a stratum independently meets n=100
measurement.forecast_error: not measurable without historical Fundamental Service forecasts; no forecast-performance claim or threshold promotion without a separate predeclared variance and OOS error gate
source_exclusions: current ticker lists or current survival status
